detailedPairs.key: [L189-Q1-0] Analogous
detailedPairs.cleanKey: Analogous

detailedPairs.key: [L189-Q1-1] Parallel

detailedPairs.key: [L189-Q1-2] Disanalogous
detailedPairs.cleanKey: Disanalogous

detailedPairs.key: [L189-Q1-3] Instructive
detailedPairs.cleanKey: Instructive

detailedPairs.key: [L189-Q1-4] Cautionary

detailedPairs.rationale: Connects "Others treat it mainly as a cautionary tale about acting too slowly." directly to the defining quality "Others, mainly, warning".

quests.paragraphTopic: Vocabulary for the strength of a claim

detailedPairs.key: [L190-Q1-0] Limited
detailedPairs.cleanKey: Limited

detailedPairs.key: [L190-Q1-4] Hedged
